out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: OBSERVED EGGS ON THE MENU WITHOUT A CONSUMER ADVISORY. OWNER CONFIRMED THEY ARE OFFERED RAW OR UNDERCOOKED UPON REQUEST.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PLEASE ADD AN ASTERISK NEXT TO EACH EGG ITEM ON THE MENU THAT CAN BE ORDERED RAW OR UNDERCOOKED. AT THE BOTTOM OF THE MENU, PLEASE ADD THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT (OR OTHERWISE APPROVED CONSUMER ADVISORY) WITH AN ASTERISK: *This item may be served undercooked. Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness. PLEASE CORRECT THIS ITEM BY JULY 19TH.

violations.title: Cooking & Baking Equipment, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The (cavity, door seal) of the microwave oven is observed soiled. The inside walls and door of the microwave was heavily soiled with food debris.
violations.corrective_action: The interiors of all microwave ovens including cavities, door seals, floors, walls, and ceilings shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure. Clean microwave every day to prevent build up of food debris.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: different bottles of condiments and sauces in kitchen area were not identified with their names.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Discussed with CFM all items taken out of the commercial containers must be labeled in the new containers.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed several wet wiping cloths on the counters and prep table not stored in sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Discussed with CFM, CFM placed wet wiping cloths in the sanitizer bucket.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: the sides, top and inside doors of the prep top refrigerator and sides of the prep table and need to be cleaned regularly.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean all surfaces of equipment regularly.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the wall in behind the meat slicer is soiled with food debris and is in need of cleaning. Racks holding packages of bread observed with dust and debris.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the walls, tables and racks regularly to prevent build up of food debris and dust.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the bucket with a concentration of 10 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. CFM ADDED MORE BLEACH TO BUCKET AND SANITIZER LEVEL WAS RAISED TO 200 PPM.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed pesticides and plant food sitting on table right next to coffee machine.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CFM MOVED ITEMS INTO STORAGE CLOSET AWAY FROM FOOD ITEMS AND CONTACT SURFACES.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: microwave, inside of freezer and refrigerators and wall behind the slicer had food debris and grime on them.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CFM TO CLEAN THE SURFACES

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the FOOD CONTACT SURFACES at the toaster area and prep counters, and interior of refrigerators have food sediments and other debris on and around it and are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with the owner and have instructed to clean and sanitize the surfacesareas noted within 48 hours. Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Sliced cheese in the 2 DR Prep refrigerator was observed at 49 F.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with the owner, the cheese has been moved to the freezer. Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The concentration of the Chlorine SANITIZER solution in a tub in the 3 VAT sink area was measured at above 200 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with the owner, and adjusted the concentration of sanitizer solution to around 100 ppm. Maintain the concentration of Chlorine SANITIZER solution at 50-200 ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit.
